Game Overview

At its heart, Super Brain is a casual game about race through "Gates of Knowledge" as you swiftly answer challenging questions to keep moving forward. Quick thinking and fast reflexes are key in this thrilling blend of speed and smarts. Make nimble decisions to keep your run alive and see how far your intellect can take you!
